body:
This really burns my ass, Patrick.  The following two sentences, used as 
two thirds of the lead for your highly misleading "Unabomber Linked to 
EF!" page, are lifted almost verbatim from one of my  posts.  

"The last two people the Unabomber killed were with organizations
targeted for criticism in EF! literature (an ad executive with who
worked for Exxon Oil's Ad firm, and the executive with a timber
industry lobbying group.) The advertising agency was specifically
mentioned at the presentation he attended, according to the event
organizer interviewed by ABC News last night (Friday, 5 April)." 

(http://www.off-road.com/green/ef_unabomber_tie.html)

Versus

"The last two people  the Unabomber killed were with organizations 
targeted for criticism in EF! literature (the ad exec with the outfit 
that whored for Exon, and the  executive with the lobbying group that 
whored for the timber industry.)  The advertising agency was specifically 
mentioned at the presentation he  attended, according to the event 
organizer interviewed by ABC News last night (Friday, 5 April)."
( <4k6msb$k96@news.ycc.yale.edu> )

(and again, I apologize for stating incorrectly that the timber lobbying 
group was mentioned in EF! literature.  It appears to've been mentioned 
in literature from a different environmental organization.)

Chicas, let me tell you a few things -- I don't appreciate being 
plagiarized, to start with.  I particularly don't like it when you're 
pulling my words out of their context to justify your position, and when 
I later clarified my posting.  

As it stands now, ABC has not been able to source their report back to 
the FBI, only to their lobbyist.  No evidence beyond that single report 
that K was at the meeting has been presented.  Your entire webpage 
appears based on my reporting back my hearing of the ABC newscast, not 
even having seen it yourself, as far as I can tell.  

Patrick, you are a plagiarist, as well as a liar in many of your posts 
-- extending what you read in my post far beyond what the post had said 
and into what you wanted it to read.  

As for lying, let's see what you've written more recently, having 
established in your own mind a linkage you've seen in a Usenet post:

In article <4kf7us$r2h@nuhou.aloha.net> pjc@aloha.net (Patrick J. Chicas) writes:
>kelly.cowan@ebbs.cts.com wrote:
>
><snip>
>: You still have not provided me with substantiation of the EF/Ted tie.  That
>: post is not adequate.  He attended a EF CONVENTION a few years back?  Give
>: me a break.  He also went to the corner store.
>
>You have answered your own question partly.
>
>Take it a bit further to include the following:
>
>-Co-support on luddite, anti-human and deep ecological ideals.

There is no mention of deep ecology in the Manifesto.  

>-Co-support for "defense of Earth without compromise".

There is no mention of "defense of Earth without compromise" in the 
Manifesto.  The Manifesto concerns itself primarily with an argument 
about returning humans to power over their own lives, which Una argues 
has been wrested from them by technology.  He agrees that environmental 
problems are a concern growing out of technology, but his primary 
motivation is about the role of technology as an alienating or 
abstracting factor removing people from control over their lives.  

He also writes:  "But there are growing numbers of people who in one way 
or another are rebels against the system: welfare leaches, youth gangs 
cultists, satanists, nazis, radical environmentalists, militiamen, etc.."
(Manifesto, section 161).  

Are each of these groups allied with the Unabomber?  

>-Unabomber killed listees from the 'EF, Eco Fucker Hit List" shortly after
> being introduced to said list.

When was Una introduced to this list?  The meeting Kaczynski attended, 
which as others have clarified and as I mistakenly referred to as an EF! 
meeting was not -- it was a meeting of different environmental group.  
The list you refer to was not reported by ABC to have been at that 
meeting -- their report documented only a reference to Exon's advertising 
firm.  

The list you refer to *was not produced by EF!* in any case.  

>Your saying thet the FBI blew up Barri? Why would they do that? Any 
>entity would gain far more damage over EF by simply framing the dupes 
>into being caught with the bomb. I say they blew themselves up.

Ah, Patrick?  The FBI tried *very* hard to, as you correctly write, "frame 
the dupes."  If they'd been killed, there'd have been no one to defend 
them, and as an added bonus, Barri's organizing would be *over.*

>As I remember, the bomb carried 8 penny nails with the same machine stamp 
>as those found at one of their residences.

Was this ever introduced as evidence in court, or was this another 
"anonymous FBI source" of the sort we've all gotten used to hearing from 
in the last few years making prejudicial pretrial statements?  

>Wake up! The "public" associates EF with the Unabomber.

No, Patrick, one lying, plagiarizing piece of offroad scum does.  The 
"public" hasn't, to the best of my knowledge, been polled on this topic.  

-Peter

Who wonders what, if anything, our delegate from the offroad community 
knows about Couch's Spadefoot.
